Kernel and network setup stages for hugetlbfs, sysctl, hyperthreads, ethtool, and snapshots.

# Purpose
The `fdctl configure` documentation defines a host setup command that prepares a Linux system for Firedancer by applying required kernel, memory, CPU, and network settings. It groups the work into stages such as `hugetlbfs`, `sysctl`, `hyperthreads`, `ethtool-channels`, `ethtool-offloads`, `ethtool-loopback`, and `snapshots`, and it supports `init`, `check`, and `fini` modes to apply, verify, or reverse each stage where possible. The file explains which settings are required, which are optional, and which actions need root privileges, so operators can configure the host before starting the validator. It also documents the effect of each stage on system resources, such as huge page reservation, kernel parameter tuning, CPU core placement, NIC queue setup, and loopback traffic support.
